description: Use this when every message in a conversation should gain or lose the same labels, including marking the thread read, or when the thread should move to inbox, archive, spam, or trash. Requires auth. Works on a paused inbox. Inputs: inbox_id (required; inbox id, username, or email), thread_id (required), add_labels (optional strings), remove_labels (optional strings), folder (optional; inbox, archive, spam, or trash), block_sender (optional boolean; only with folder spam). The label change is applied to every message in the thread. read and unread can be changed. Other system labels (inbox, sent, untrusted, auth_failed, owner, and SPF/DKIM/DMARC results) cannot. Moving to the same folder twice changes nothing and emits no event. Moving to inbox removes the folder row. Trash sets purge_after to 30 days after the move. block_sender adds the latest inbound From address to the inbox receive block list and returns blocked_sender. Returns the thread plus messages_updated, and blocked_sender when block_sender was true. The thread includes assignment, folder, and purge_after. Unknown thread returns HTTP 404 thread_not_found. Invalid labels return invalid_label, protected_label, or label_conflict. A bad folder returns invalid_folder. block_sender without folder spam returns invalid_block_sender.

add_labels.description: Labels to add on every message. read and unread are allowed. System labels are not.

block_sender.description: When true, and only with folder spam, add the thread's latest inbound From address to the inbox receive block list. Returns blocked_sender. Without folder spam this returns invalid_block_sender.

folder.description: Move the thread to inbox, archive, spam, or trash. inbox removes the folder row. The same folder twice is a no-op. A bad value returns invalid_folder.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email address owned by this key

remove_labels.description: Labels to remove from every message. Pass ["unread"] to mark the thread read.

thread_id.description: Thread id (thr_…) whose messages should change labels

name: cooper_update_thread
title: Update thread labels
